title: allow paste and drag
rule: Allow copy/paste (never block paste) and, where the platform supports it, drag-and-drop into the field.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Designing Mobile Input Fields; Vercel Web Interface Guidelines; Apple HIG — Entering data

pass_when: Paste into the field works; copy out works; drag-and-drop works where the platform supports it.
fail_when: Paste is blocked or stripped by the field.
overview: Allow paste into fields; support drag-and-drop where the platform can.
apply_when: Text or value entry where users may paste or drop content.
not_when: Platforms that cannot offer drag-and-drop into the field.
agent_hint: Never block paste; enable drag-and-drop where the platform supports it.
description: Copy/paste must work into the field — never block paste — and where the platform supports it, drag-and-drop into the field should work too. Pass when paste in, copy out, and supported drag-and-drop succeed; fail when paste is blocked or stripped by the field. This recovers users who bring values from elsewhere instead of forcing retyping.
